notes: Form 990 filings found on ProPublica (EIN 943062436).

No SEC filings. Form 990 line 5 (513 for 2024, 518 for 2023, 475 for 2022) counts everyone issued a W-2 during the year, so it may run above point-in-time headcount. Third-party estimates (299-458) and LinkedIn members (331-341; another snippet shows 331) sit below the 990 figures; not reconciled. LinkedIn snippet may be stale. ZoomInfo and Indeed give only a 201-500 range, so they are not recorded as sources. Website 13 million and 100,000 tiles are service-population figures, and the 15 employees is a historical figure for the predecessor CTDN, so none are headcounts. No confirmed M&A, layoffs or hiring events.
